nextSafeAction: Before a real sandbox session, select only the TuiVision checkout as the writable project source and obtain the required owner approval for data class, provider use, and current network risk.
residualRisk: The image has useful technical isolation, but formal approval, provider decisions, unrestricted Compose egress, lifecycle dates, and current platform execution remain open.

controls.rationale: The sandbox repository documents a Podman container and an approval draft, but the responsible human approval and expiry are not complete.
controls.residualRisk: Use without formal approval may exceed the accepted data or provider boundary.
controls.followUp: Approve the sandbox type, image identifier, tools, models, mount list, data class, and expiry before operational use.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: Formal approval is issued, expires, or the image identity changes.

controls.rationale: Compose exposes explicit mounts, but its project-root variables can be configured too broadly. TuiVision use requires the selected checkout only.
controls.residualRisk: A broad local environment value could expose unrelated projects.
controls.followUp: Review the local Compose environment before each session and bind only the selected TuiVision checkout.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: Compose mounts or local project-root configuration changes.

controls.rationale: Agent and build state use separate named volumes and remain outside the TuiVision repository.
controls.residualRisk: Volume contents remain local operational data and require normal host protection.
controls.followUp: Review after agent-state paths or volume names change.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: Agent storage, cache, or Compose volume configuration changes.

controls.rationale: The sandbox separates local environment input, denies common sensitive reads, and TuiVision runs repository secret scans.
controls.residualRisk: An operator can still disclose a secret manually in a prompt or command.
controls.followUp: Keep prompts, logs, screenshots, and Evidence free of credentials and sensitive personal data.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: Secret injection, scanner, prompt logging, or agent permission rules change.

controls.rationale: The image pins tool versions and disables uncontrolled updates, but installation is not provider, account, license, or model approval.
controls.residualRisk: Provider region, retention, training use, account rights, and model approval are not established here.
controls.followUp: Approve each selected provider, account, model, region, retention policy, and license before login.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: A tool, provider, model, account, contract, or version changes.

controls.rationale: TuiVision uses Spec Kit with twelve enabled governance presets, current intake review, sequencing, model routing, and autonomous run evidence.
controls.residualRisk: Preset drift can invalidate generated agent or template surfaces.
controls.followUp: Re-run preset resolution, agent parity, and intake gates after preset changes.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: Spec Kit, preset, template, agent, or intake policy changes.

controls.rationale: Feature automation and remote checks cannot replace the human approval required by the generic CL-12 control.
controls.residualRisk: A technically green PR may still lack independent human review.
controls.followUp: Obtain human review when organizational policy requires it; do not classify an unavailable reviewer as Pass.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: A human review is submitted or repository approval policy changes.

controls.rationale: Feature state, accepted hashes, task completion, PR Evidence, commit provenance, and metadata-only audit boundaries provide traceability.
controls.residualRisk: Provider session content remains intentionally outside repository evidence.
controls.followUp: Keep audit evidence metadata-only and bind final delivery to the exact reviewed head.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: Audit schema, run-state schema, or provider evidence changes.

controls.rationale: Non-root execution, no-new-privileges, dropped capabilities and explicit mounts are documented, while formal protection-level acceptance remains open.
controls.residualRisk: A container is not a complete VM boundary and writable mounts expose their selected content.
controls.followUp: Approve the protection level for the intended data class and repeat practical isolation checks on the current image.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: Image, runtime, capability, user, mount, or data classification changes.

controls.rationale: Codex workspace-write disables shell network access, but the general Compose environment intentionally retains unrestricted egress.
controls.residualRisk: Other tools and processes can reach destinations outside an explicit allowlist.
controls.followUp: Accept the dated egress risk or provide a tested proxy, DNS filter, or equivalent allowlist before sensitive use.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: Network policy, endpoints, package sources, providers, or accepted risk date changes.

controls.rationale: The technical reference is current, but formal approval expiry and periodic revalidation ownership are incomplete.
controls.residualRisk: An undated approval can remain in use after material image or provider drift.
controls.followUp: Set an approval date, expiry, review cadence, and evidence owner.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: Approval is issued, expires, or any bound source hash changes.

controls.rationale: The current local preset matrix is enabled, resolved in priority order, and model routing is aligned before Feature 044.
controls.residualRisk: Future preset updates may change required evidence or generated surfaces.
controls.followUp: Repeat preset, routing, generated-surface, and agent-parity checks after updates.
controls.reevaluationTrigger: A preset version, priority, template, command, or routing catalog changes.

mounts.purpose: Read and modify only the selected TuiVision checkout for an authorized task.
mounts.allowedContent: The TuiVision Git checkout and task-owned generated temporary output ignored by Git.
mounts.excludedContent: The parent project directory, sibling repositories, credentials, personal files, and unrelated worktrees.
mounts.reevaluationTrigger: The checkout location, Compose variables, or task authority changes.

mounts.purpose: Provide the sandbox's own controlled maintenance files; TuiVision work treats this checkout as read-only reference.
mounts.excludedContent: TuiVision changes, credentials, and unrelated host files.
mounts.reevaluationTrigger: The self-mount access mode or TuiVision task scope changes.

mounts.purpose: Represent separate tool-specific named volumes for agent sessions and configuration.
mounts.allowedContent: Agent-local state managed by the selected tool.
mounts.excludedContent: Versioned project files, exported prompts, responses, tokens, and broad home-directory copies.
mounts.reevaluationTrigger: Agent home, state format, export policy, or volume mapping changes.

mounts.purpose: Keep .NET build output outside the source mount.
mounts.excludedContent: Source, credentials, permanent Evidence, and release claims.
mounts.reevaluationTrigger: Build output paths or volume strategy change.

mounts.purpose: Store narrowly allowed metadata for traceability.
mounts.allowedContent: Tool, version, session identifier, timestamp, project role, and actor metadata.
mounts.excludedContent: Prompts, responses, source contents, tokens, credentials, and raw session files.
mounts.reevaluationTrigger: Audit fields, export paths, or retention rules change.

mounts.excludedContent: TuiVision version overrides and other host configuration.

mounts.purpose: Make the exclusion of unrelated host data explicit.
mounts.excludedContent: Home, desktop, downloads, sibling repositories, credential stores, browser profiles, and private user data.
mounts.reevaluationTrigger: A new host bind mount is proposed.

executions.proofBoundary: The pinned .NET 10 SDK and source layout make the command feasible; Feature 044 does not claim a fresh image execution.
executions.reevaluationTrigger: SDK, solution, native dependency, or image changes.

executions.proofBoundary: The command is structurally feasible; current sandbox execution is not claimed by this audit.
executions.reevaluationTrigger: Test runtime, SDK, solution, terminal, or native requirements change.

executions.proofBoundary: The SDK provides the command; no practical sandbox run is claimed.
GitHub Actions installs DocFX and proves publication input; the base sandbox image does not claim a preinstalled DocFX command.
executions.reevaluationTrigger: DocFX installation, workflow, or documentation configuration changes.

executions.proofBoundary: CI proves the DocFX Playwright/Axe path; a generic sandbox browser installation is not assumed.
executions.reevaluationTrigger: Browser, Node, Playwright, Axe, or Pages workflow changes.

executions.proofBoundary: CI reviews packages and creates a temporary CycloneDX SBOM; it does not make a permanent VEX or release provenance claim.
executions.reevaluationTrigger: Dependency, package source, release, SBOM, VEX, or workflow scope changes.

executions.proofBoundary: Scanners cover committed and candidate repository content; they cannot prevent intentional disclosure to a provider prompt.
executions.reevaluationTrigger: Scanner rules, agent directories, logging, or secret paths change.

executions.proofBoundary: The check proves generated surface parity in this checkout, not provider availability or login.
executions.reevaluationTrigger: Agent, integration, skill, prompt, template, or preset changes.
